title: Shortest Subarray with Sum at Least K
goal: Find the shortest nonempty subarray with sum at least k even when values are negative.
strategy: Prefix sums turn a range sum into a difference. A deque retains candidate starts with increasing prefix sums; discard satisfied starts after recording their lengths and discard dominated larger prefixes from the back.
